# Data for matured noninterest-bearing debt (in millions) from fiscal years 1960-1967
data = {
    1960: 280,
    1961: 240,
    1962: 211,
    1963: 157,
    1964: 139,
    1965: 110,
    1966: 95,
    1967: 88
}

alpha = 0.4

# Single exponential smoothing
# Initialize S_1 with the first observation
years = sorted(data.keys())
values = [data[y] for y in years]

# S_1 = X_1 (first observation)
S = {}
S[years[0]] = values[0]

print(f"Year {years[0]}: X = {values[0]}, S = {S[years[0]]}")

# Calculate smoothed values for each subsequent year
for i in range(1, len(years)):
    year = years[i]
    X = values[i]
    prev_year = years[i-1]
    S[year] = alpha * X + (1 - alpha) * S[prev_year]
    print(f"Year {year}: X = {X}, S = {S[year]:.4f}")

# Forecast for 1968: S_1968 (the smoothed value for 1967 becomes the forecast for 1968)
forecast_1968 = S[1967]
print(f"\nForecast for 1968 (using S_1967): {forecast_1968:.2f}")

# Alternatively, some methods compute one step ahead forecast
# Let's also verify by computing the forecast
print(f"\nFinal answer (rounded to 2 decimal places): {forecast_1968:.2f}")
EOF
